steps.label: Restricted

eyebrow: Enforcing a standard on a namespace
code:
apiVersion: v1
kind: Namespace
metadata:
  name: payments
  labels:
    pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce: restricted
    pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce-version: latest
    pod-security.kubernetes.io/audit: restricted
    pod-security.kubernetes.io/warn: restricted
caption: Pod Security Admission reads these labels — no extra component to install, on by default since 1.25.

eyebrow: A Pod that actually passes Restricted
code:
spec:
  securityContext:
    runAsNonRoot: true
    runAsUser: 10001
    seccompProfile:
      type: RuntimeDefault
  containers:
    - name: app
      image: billing-api:2.3
      securityContext:
        allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
        readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
        capabilities:
          drop: ["ALL"]
caption: The label only enforces it — the securityContext is what actually satisfies the standard.
